title: Sources: the White House plans to unveil a federal AI framework on Friday covering preemption of state laws, child safety, communities, creators, and censorship (Axios)
summary: Axios: Sources: the White House plans to unveil a federal AI framework on Friday covering preemption of state laws, child safety, communities, creators, and censorship — The White House is expected to send Congress its ideas for regulating AI on Friday, sources familiar with the matter told Axios …
